claim.description: The seller's statement, quoted or shortened.
claim.title: Claim

evidence.description: The photo that proves or contradicts it, or what is missing.
evidence.title: Evidence

status.description: named: a brand and model read off the item. by_type: a kind in a buyer's words, for items that carry no model. unknown: the photos do not say.
status.title: Status

kind.description: The item in a buyer's words, for example 'standing fan'.
kind.title: Kind

read_from.description: Where the identity was read: 'photo 2 plate', 'photo 1 screen'. Never the seller's text alone.
read_from.title: Read From

low.description: Number of the comparable to use as the low end.
low.title: Low

high.description: Number of the comparable to use as the high end.
high.title: High

risk.description: Something that could be wrong and that the photos cannot show.
risk.title: Risk

proof.description: The one shot, screenshot or clip that would settle it.
proof.title: Proof

if_unproven.description: How it is priced until proven, for example 'as not working'.
if_unproven.title: If Unproven

observations.description: What the photos show, before any decision. Short lines.
observations.title: Observations

proof_requests.description: What to ask the seller for next, most decisive first.
proof_requests.title: Proof Requests

reason.description: One or two sentences. No prices.
reason.title: Reason

price_pick.description: Only when decision is price: comparables sorted cheapest first, picked by number.
